messages:
marta: heads up — PaperTrail (customer) opened a ticket: webhooks to their endpoint are getting 403s starting ~2026-03-17T12:02Z after our egress maintenance. They only allowlist a single IP. Can infra confirm if SNATs rotated? :eyes:

samir: on it. do we have a sample request id or headers from their failed deliveries?

marta: pasted from their webhook delivery: `{"status":403,"body":"Forbidden - verification failed","headers":{"X-Request-ID":"pt-8a3f4c","X-Webhook-Verification":"fingerprint-mismatch"}}`

marta: customer says their firewall logs show incoming source IP 34.199.101.77 at 12:02:11Z which isn't in their allowlist. They confirmed only 34.199.88.12 was whitelisted.

infra-bot: deployment-notice: egress-nat-rotate completed at 2026-03-17T12:00:00Z. Rotated SNATs for us-west-2: old pool 34.199.88.0/28 -> new pool includes 34.199.101.76-79.

june: looks like classic allowlist drift. The webhook server returns a verification header when source IP changes — their firewall rejects anything not in the list, hence fingerprint-mismatch.

samir: confirmed via BGP/NAT logs: host 10.42.7.12 NATd to 34.199.101.77 during the window. I'll pull a flow log sample and ask netops to mark 34.199.101.77 as an active egress for that tenant's AZ.

marta: customer asked whether this is expected and if we can provide a stable egress for them. They're on Private VPC (papertrail-prod) with webhooks -> third-party.

samir: short answer: SNAT rotation is expected in our autoscale/maintenance path for Private clusters unless a customer requests a pinned egress block. Workarounds: 1) ask customer to allowlist our full egress pool for that region (we can share CIDR), 2) request a reserved static egress allocation (requires an ops ticket), 3) we can temporarily add the observed IP to a support exceptions list while they update.

marta: shared remediation to customer: add 34.199.101.77 and 34.199.102.44 (we gave two likely peers) or allowlist the region CIDR 34.199.96.0/22. They said they need confirmation we rotated the SNAT during maintenance.

june: repro steps for internal docs (short):
```
# from support playbook
1) check infra-bot deployment logs for egress-nat-rotate timestamp
2) query netops NAT mapping: `rgw-natctl get-mappings --tenant papertrail-prod --since 2026-03-17T11:50`
3) check VPC flow logs for source 10.42.7.12 -> NAT IP 34.199.101.77
4) confirm with customer firewall logs and ask them to temporarily whitelist highlighted IPs
```

samir: actioned — added 34.199.101.77 to temporary support-exceptions pool at 2026-03-17T12:15Z. netops will open a request to provision a reserved egress block if customer wants that long-term.

marta: customer confirmed deliveries resumed at 12:17Z after we supplied the IP and they updated their allowlist. They asked for docs on 'how we manage SNAT rotations' — I'll attach the public runbook link to the ticket. :thumbsup:

june: recommend we follow up with a note in onboarding docs for Private customers: suggest allowlisting region CIDR or request reserved egress to avoid this class of failure. I'll file a doc update.

marta: ticket #PT-12345 updated with timeline, temp IPs, and next steps (customer considering reserved egress). closing channel once ticket is synced. Thanks all.
